# Cracktro voice track

The kiosk voice (V) plays `docs/public/cracktro/voice/<slide id>.webm`. Each file is a two-anchor
read of that slide's `slides.md` Captions. `voice/index.js` (`window.CracktroVoice`) maps each slide id to
`[caption hash, duration s]`. The runtime plays a file only when its hash matches the slide's current captions.
Any other slide falls back to browser `speechSynthesis`, so a stale file never speaks the wrong words.

- Voices, timing, encoding and pronunciations (`lexicon`) are in `voice.json`. Editing it changes the config fingerprint and rebuilds every slide.
- Anchor identities and caption-writing rules are in `personas.md`. Read it before writing captions.
- Encoding choices and model licences are in `../speech-audio-encoding/SKILL.md`.

## When captions change (mandatory)

Run these from the repository root, then commit `voice/index.js` together with the changed `.webm` files:

```bash
node .github/skills/cracktro-voice/voice.mjs check           # dependency-free; exit 1 lists stale/missing/orphan slides
node .github/skills/cracktro-voice/voice.mjs build --deps "$TMPDIR/voicegen" --jobs 6
node .github/skills/cracktro-voice/voice.mjs check           # must print "voice track in sync"
```

`docs/tests/talk.spec.ts` ("keeps the recorded voice track in sync…") fails when the track is stale or has orphan
files, or when it exceeds the size budget. If you can't run the build, say so in the PR. The deck still speaks the
changed slides through the fallback.

## Setup (once per machine)

```bash
npm install --prefix "$TMPDIR/voicegen" kokoro-js@1.2.1 ffmpeg-static@5.3.0
```

The first build downloads Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0, about 330 MB) into the Hugging Face cache.

## Build options

- `build` rebuilds only stale slides. Add `--slides a,b` to limit it to specific ids, or `--force` to rebuild everything.
- `--jobs N` sets the number of parallel synth workers; `--threads N` sets ONNX threads per worker. On an Apple M-series laptop, 6 jobs take about 2.5 min for a full rebuild.
- `--cache DIR` (default `$TMPDIR/cracktro-voice-cache`) caches clips by engine, voice, speed and text. Changing only timing or encoding re-encodes without resynthesizing.
- `--ffmpeg PATH` overrides ffmpeg-static.
- onnxruntime may abort when the process exits after a successful build. Trust `check`, not the exit code.

## Auditioning a voice change

Render the same caption with the candidate voices or speeds into a scratch folder, either under `$TMPDIR` or a
temporary, uncommitted directory under `docs/public/cracktro/`. Play them in the browser canvas and let the
author pick. Then update `voice.json` and `personas.md` together and run a full `build`. Keep the 32 kbps
`application audio` encode: `voip` and lower bitrates sound robotic.

## Runtime wiring

- `docs/public/cracktro/index.html` loads `./voice/index.js` before `deck.js`.
- `deck.js` passes `voice: window.CracktroVoice` to `CracktroDeck.create`. Its type (`base`, `slides`) is in `runtime.d.ts`.
- In `runtime.js`, `voiceClip(i)` returns the clip URL when `captionHash` matches, and `voicePlay` plays it. On an error or a rejected `play()`, it falls back to `voiceSpeak`.
- The hash is `captionHash` in `docs/src/lib/cracktro/slides.js`. Keep the runtime copy identical.
- `captions.js` is generated by the docs build and dev server. Under the bare `python3 -m http.server` preview there are no captions, so no audio plays. Use `npm run dev` in `docs/` to hear the track.

## Rules

- Files live only in `docs/public/cracktro/voice/`; never under `assets/` (avatars only).
- Never add URLs to `runtime.js` or `deck.js`; clips load relative to the deck.
- Never commit audition samples.
